headline: CI status now names real terminal states, and Lighthouse release bars are explicit per route.

items.title: CI status terminal-state beacon
items.insight: The public CI beacon now says what actually happened. A known Cloudflare token-scope failure no longer looks like a vague CI fire or a still-running gate.

items.title: Lighthouse route-tier budgets
items.insight: Lighthouse now has named route expectations instead of one blunt threshold. The gate is stricter where the evidence supports it and explicit where the route is still lab-volatile.

honestyLedger.title: Homepage 0.85 not claimed
honestyLedger.why: Current committed Lighthouse evidence puts / around 0.76, so the route-tier gate enforces the observed floor and records stricter homepage performance as a future trace-backed carry.

honestyLedger.title: Post-push CI still pending
honestyLedger.why: Remote Lighthouse cannot be called green until this commit lands and the workflow reruns with the S270 route-tier checker.

followUps: Confirm post-push Lighthouse CI under route-tier floors.
Repair CF_WORKER_API_TOKEN R2 scope for vaultspark-rum.
Run a focused homepage Lighthouse performance sprint before restoring a 0.85 homepage tier.
blockers: Worker deploy remains provider-token-scope gated on Cloudflare R2 Bucket Read/Edit.
